scope_statement: Mobility, independence, sport and lifelong health.
source_note: No sources were retrieved. The generation environment had no access to PubMed, Cochrane, the knowledge base or any textbook. The Tier 1 source minimum is NOT met and this draft would not pass Tier 1 in the deployed pipeline.
claims_needing_verification: The knee is the principal joint of walking and of the sit to stand transfer.
It lies between the two longest bones, so forces act through long lever arms.
Joint reaction forces in ordinary activity are several times body weight.
Functional consequences of knee disease extend to fitness, falls risk and wellbeing.
Structural appearance correlates imperfectly with symptoms and with function.
